thread:
sophia: Quick checkpoint on console observability roadmap — dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, retention milestones. Need owners, blockers, and clear milestones for next sprint. TL;DR: dashboards mostly wired, tracing hooks blocked on infra header propagation, error views waiting on event schema, retention policy needs product/legal signoff.

michael: Can you call out the specific infra change blocking tracing? I want to see if it's a config flip or platform work.

ada: Tracing hooks need the agent to forward X-Trace-* headers to the collector and preserve sampling flags. PR opened: #842 (agent-lib header-propagation). @raj can you review when you have a sec? Also need a staging canary.

raj: I'll take a look today. On retention, legal pushed 90d as default, but product prefers 30d for cost. @claire do you have a final preference? Need this for rollout plan.

claire: Product leans 30d default for self-serve, offer 90d as enterprise opt-in. I'll update the RFC and add the rollout notes by EOD.

enginfra-bot: staging cluster "obs-canary-02" is provisioned and ready in us-west-2 :white_check_mark:

devex: Heads up — the agent change will bump the agent SDK minor version. We'll need release notes and a quick migration guide for customers.

sophia: Action items: (1) @raj review PR #842 by 2026-06-10, (2) @claire finalize retention decision + update RFC by EOD, (3) @michael own staging canary and health checklist, (4) devex prepare migration snippet. Target milestone: "obs-v2" with goal date 2026-06-17. Ping here if any capacity or security blockers.

michael: I can own the canary. ETA for readiness: 2026-06-14. I'll drop a checklist in the thread and tag infra on any quota requests.

ada: I added a tiny test harness to the PR to simulate header forwarding. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.console.redwood/api/events
  -H "X-Trace-Id: 12345"
  -H "X-Trace-Sampled: 1"
  -d '{"span": "ui.click", "msg":"test"}'
```

raj: Reviewing now. Quick note: looks like we need a small tweak to preserve lowercase headers in the forwarding code. I'll leave comments and request a squash.

claire: RFC updated: added retention default 30d + enterprise toggle for 90d. Link: https://docs.redwood/internal/rfcs/obs-retention (will add rollout checklist).

enginfra-bot: quota request created for canary: ticket INFRA-719. Assigned to michaela.s.

michael: Thanks. I'll follow up with michaela and post progress.

devex: Drafted migration blurb and example snippet, putting it in the docs PR now. Will tag @sophia for copy review.

ada: thx all. once @raj approves I'll merge and coordinate canary tests.

raj: Approved with minor fixes, marked "needs-squash". Will re-review post-squash. :thumbsup:
